subtitle.zh: TouchDesigner 实时声音可视化交互

description.zh: 通过 TouchDesigner 将蝴蝶几何、粒子反馈与实时声音分析连接，生成持续蜕变的视听形态。
description.en: TouchDesigner connects butterfly geometry, particle feedback, and live audio analysis to create an evolving audiovisual form.

kind.zh: 创意编程／实时视听交互

coverAlt.zh: 液态背景中的青蓝色蝴蝶骨骸模型，白色粒子围绕形态扩散。
coverAlt.en: A cyan skeletal butterfly against a liquid background, surrounded by dispersing white particles.

role.zh: 模型处理、节点编程、声音映射与视觉合成
role.en: Geometry processing, node programming, audio mappings, and visual compositing

stage.zh: 几何建模、粒子生成、声音响应与实时输出
stage.en: Geometry, particle generation, audio response, and live output

deliverables.zh: 完整节点分析、五阶段演进、实时视听影像与声音交互
deliverables.en: Operator analysis, five-stage development, live audiovisual film, and audio interaction

overview.zh: 以蝴蝶形骨骸模型为视觉核心，将三维几何重构为不断生成、扰动与回流的粒子。声音经分析、放大和平滑后，驱动粒子湍动与模型缩放；液态背景、反馈与辉光共同建立有机的视听关系，让形态随声音强弱不断蜕变。
overview.en: A butterfly-shaped skeletal model becomes a continuously generated, disturbed, and returning particle field. Analysed, amplified, and smoothed audio drives turbulence and model scale. A liquid background, feedback, and bloom establish an organic audiovisual relationship in which form changes with sound intensity.
